# Social Owls

> Social Owls is a strategy-first social media and branding agency with offices in Egypt and the UAE, working with brands across the UAE & Egypt. 66 brand partners in travel, food & beverage, fashion, tech, healthcare, industry and more.

Social Owls (socialowls.agency) is a strategy-first social media and branding agency founded in 2021 by Mary Gaied, with offices in Egypt and the UAE. We build positioning, brand identities and social media content systems that connect content to business growth.

Contact: letstalk@socialowls.agency · UAE +971 50 508 9055 · Egypt +20 155 633 1102

## Services
- Brand Consultancy: Brand audit, Brand strategy & positioning, Brand architecture, Messaging & tone of voice
- Brand Identity: Corporate identity, Logo & visual system, Literature system, Brand guidelines, Marketing templates
- Digital Branding: Digital strategy, Content strategy, Content development, Brand asset management
- Social Media Management: Social media strategy, Profiles management, Creative concepts & design, Community management
- Content Creation: Photography, Videography, Reels & short-form video, Product & lifestyle shoots
- Digital PR: Influencer management, Media management, Reputation management, Content marketing
- Media Planning & Buying: Media strategy, Paid social campaigns, Budget allocation, Audience targeting, Reporting & analytics
